name: Current weather for a place
description: Returns the current weather for a named place, asked of several independent weather services at once and read straight from whichever answers first. Always gives the temperature and humidity; the sky and the wind come too when the service that wins the race reports them. Takes the place on its own, such as "Bishkek" or "Tokyo", never a whole sentence. Use this instead of searching the web whenever the question is about the weather somewhere.

place.description: the place whose weather is asked about

name: Exchange rate between two currencies
description: Returns how much one unit of a base currency is worth in a quote currency, asked of several rate services at once. Takes base and quote as three-letter uppercase codes, e.g. base USD, quote EUR. Use this instead of searching the web whenever the question is about an exchange rate.

base.description: Three-letter uppercase code of the currency being converted FROM, e.g. USD.

quote.description: Three-letter uppercase code of the currency being converted TO, e.g. EUR.
